ext_description.message: Save recipes, articles and links to Mis Notas, encrypted and synced with your own Nextcloud.

opt_save_images_short.message: Keep a copy of the images

popup_not_scriptable.message: Only the link can be saved on this page.

popup_folder_queued.message: Folder created. It will be uploaded when you are back online.

popup_queued.message: Saved in the browser; it will be uploaded to Nextcloud as soon as possible

popup_not_configured.message: Connect your Nextcloud to start saving notes.

popup_locked.message: Enter your master password to encrypt your notes.

err_auth.message: Nextcloud rejected the user name or app password.

err_root_missing.message: This account has no MisNotas folder yet. Turn on sync in the Android or desktop app first.

err_vault_missing.message: keyinfo.json is missing from the MisNotas folder. Sync from the Android or desktop app first.

err_vault_changed.message: The master password was changed on another device. Enter it again in Settings.

err_server_invalid.message: The server address is not valid.

err_login_flow.message: Could not sign in with Nextcloud. Try an app password instead.

err_permission.message: Without permission to access your server the extension cannot sync.

err_fields.message: Fill in the user name and app password.

opt_subtitle.message: Save what you find on the web, encrypted in your Nextcloud.

opt_account_help.message: Use the same server as in the Android or desktop app. Notes are stored in the MisNotas folder.

opt_login_waiting.message: Grant access in the Nextcloud tab that just opened…

opt_manual_help.message: Create one in Nextcloud → Personal settings → Security → Devices & sessions. Do not use your regular password.

opt_disconnect_confirm.message: Disconnect the account from this browser? Your notes stay in Nextcloud.

opt_disconnect_confirm_pending.message: $1 item(s) have not been uploaded and will be lost. Disconnect anyway?

opt_vault_help.message: The same one you use in the apps. It never leaves this browser: notes are encrypted with it before they are sent.

opt_remember_key_help.message: The derived key is stored, not the password, and the browser does not allow reading it. If unchecked, you will be asked every time you open the browser.

opt_vault_unlocked.message: Ready. Notes are encrypted in the browser before being sent to Nextcloud.

opt_default_folder_help.message: Used by the context menu. The extension window remembers the last folder you chose.

opt_save_images.message: Keep a copy of the images

opt_save_images_help.message: They are shrunk to WebP and uploaded encrypted, like in the apps, so they do not depend on the original site.

opt_images_permission.message: Copying images from any site needs permission to download them. Without it, some will stay as links.

opt_add_source_help.message: A link to the original page at the end of the note.

opt_ingredients_tasks_help.message: In recipes, so you can tick them off while shopping or cooking.

opt_queue_help.message: They are already encrypted in this browser and are retried every 15 minutes.

opt_discard_confirm.message: Discard everything pending? This cannot be undone.

opt_about.message: Mis Notas for browsers · Free software (GPL v3) · No ads, no trackers
